# Advanced Indian Pest Solution (AIPS)

> Advanced Indian Pest Solution (AIPS) is a licensed pest control company headquartered in Kolkata, India, providing residential, commercial and industrial pest management across 18 Indian cities and 10 states. Founded in 2010, AIPS has served 40,000+ homes and businesses using CIB-approved, family-safe treatments delivered by in-house trained technicians.

## Services
- Cockroach control (odourless gel-baiting)
- Termite control (drill-and-inject anti-termite treatment, pre- and post-construction)
- Bed bug control (heat + residual spray protocol)
- Rodent control (trap-and-monitor, tamper-proof bait stations)
- Mosquito control (larvicidal treatment + residual mist)
- Ant control
- Lizard control (herbal repellent)
- Silverfish control
- Carpet beetle control
- Wood borer control
- Spider control
- Fly control
- Stored grain & seed pest control
- General pest control (combined residential package)
- Commercial pest control (HACCP/FSSAI-aligned, for restaurants, hotels, hospitals, offices, food processing)
- Herbal / botanical-only pest control (safe for newborns, asthmatics and pets)

## Areas served
Kolkata, Howrah, Hooghly, Durgapur, Asansol, Burdwan, Arambagh, Siliguri, Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Ranchi, Jamshedpur, Patna, Guwahati, Pune, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Lucknow, Varanasi — across West Bengal, Jharkhand, Bihar, Odisha, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, Assam, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
